name: Frontend Developer - React
jd_text:
Frontend Developer — PixelCraft Studios

About Us:
We build beautiful, performant web applications for creative industries.

Requirements:
- Expert-level React.js with hooks and context API
- Strong TypeScript skills
- Experience with state management (Redux or Zustand)
- CSS-in-JS or Tailwind CSS for styling
- Experience with responsive design and cross-browser compatibility
- Familiarity with RESTful API integration
- Unit testing with Jest and React Testing Library

Nice to Have:
- Experience with Next.js for SSR/SSG
- Knowledge of Figma-to-code workflows
- Experience with animation libraries (Framer Motion)
- Understanding of web accessibility (WCAG)

Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain React component libraries
- Implement pixel-perfect designs from Figma mockups
- Optimize web performance (Core Web Vitals)
- Write comprehensive unit and integration tests
